**This repository does not accept pull requests, and this one will be closed
automatically.**

It is a mirror of the Albus CLI: every release overwrites the whole tree, so a
merge here is deleted by the next published version.

Open an [issue](https://github.com/albusgroup/albus-cli/issues/new/choose)
instead and include your patch in the body. Maintainers apply the fix upstream,
and it ships in the next release, which closes the issue. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/albusgroup/albus-cli/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
